reviews.scope: 320px long-content Text Button, Input chip and Menu
reviews.finding: Labels remain contained; button and removable-chip labels use ellipsis; menu text remains readable. Screenshots inspected directly.

At checkpoint 278 the native fallback restores distinct empty, blue checked and blue mixed states. The native input computes 0 pxradius instead of the written 4 px; that source mismatch remains failed.
Selected Toggle has a native blue check and selected Radio has a native blue dot. This verifies visible browser feedback, not Croma styling or final switch artwork.
The production browser reports clip-path none and a 32 by 8 px slot with no child artwork. No triangle shape is inferred. Tooltip focus, hover, Escape and viewport containment checks pass.
